decks.notes: The deck revolves around quickly filling up the graveyard with Dredge cards like Golgari Grave-Troll, Stinkweed Imp, and Golgari Thug to bring back powerful creatures like Ichorid and Prized Amalgam. It utilizes cards like Narcomoeba and Hollow One to put pressure on the opponent while using disruption like Force of Will and Grief to protect its combo. The deck also has some utility with Noxious Revival and Force of Negation to deal with threats. The main goal is to set up a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with relentless aggression.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hate cards while deploying aggressive creatures to quickly pressure them. It utilizes cards like Anointed Peacekeeper and Archon of Emeria to slow down the opponent's game plan, while also benefiting from creatures like Clarion Conqueror and White Plume Adventurer to attack and close out the game. The deck also includes disruptive artifacts like Null Rod to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to control the game with hatebears while applying pressure with aggressive creatures to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing fast mana and card draw to assemble the necessary pieces for a powerful storm combo. Cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus, and Tolarian Academy help generate the necessary mana to cast multiple spells in a turn. Beseech the Mirror and Tendrils of Agony act as finishers once the storm count is high enough. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. The goal is to chain together spells to generate a lethal storm count and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Doomsday card to set up a winning combination of cards, specifically Thassa's Oracle and Jace, Wielder of Mysteries. The deck includes various cantrips and counterspells to help dig for and protect the combo pieces, along with cards like Demonic Tutor and Demonic Consultation to fetch them. It also features fast mana sources like Black Lotus and Moxen to accelerate the combo. The goal is to efficiently assemble the combo and win the game in a single explosive turn.

This deck focuses on using control elements like counterspells and removal spells to interact with the opponent's game plan while also leveraging the powerful card advantage engine provided by Gifts Ungiven and Lórien Revealed. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently answering threats and disrupting their strategy, all while setting up its own win condition through cards like Brain Freeze and Underworld Breach. Additionally, the deck includes powerful mana acceleration in the form of Moxen and other mana rocks to quickly deploy threats and outpace the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and generating powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Mystic Forge. It enables the player to create a powerful board presence with cards like Nettlecyst and Glaring Fleshraker while also utilizing artifacts like The One Ring and Manifold Key to control the game and shut down the opponent. With a mix of aggressive creatures and powerful artifacts, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed and efficiency in order to secure a victory in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.

The focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Dress Down to win the game. The deck includes a variety of counterspells and disruption to protect the combo and control the game, along with card draw and manipulation to find the necessary pieces. Other cards like Lórien Revealed and Doorkeeper Thrull provide additional support and utility to the deck. The mana base is streamlined and efficient, allowing for consistent access to the necessary colors and lands.

The deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo utilizing Phyrexian Dreadnought to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It combines explosive mana acceleration with powerful disruptive spells and card draw to manipulate the game to its advantage. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the late game. Key cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares help control the board while Phyrexian Dreadnought provides a fast and deadly win condition. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

Utilizing powerful artifacts and mana acceleration, this deck aims to flood the board with aggressive threats like Glaring Fleshraker and Stonecoil Serpent, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Lodestone Golem and Strip Mine. The key strategy is to quickly ramp into hard-hitting creatures and use cards like The One Ring and Manifold Key to make them even more impactful. By leveraging efficient artifacts and mana sources, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive playstyle in order to secure a quick victory.

The deck revolves around utilizing powerful reanimation spells to cheat out big threats like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game. It also includes disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces, along with Deathrite Shaman for additional graveyard interaction. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory through overwhelming board presence or efficient use of resources. It relies on efficient mana acceleration and card draw to quickly establish a dominant position on the battlefield.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hatebears and aggro creatures while utilizing mana acceleration and disruptive artifacts to maintain control of the game. It aims to restrict the opponent's ability to cast spells efficiently while presenting threats that can quickly end the game. The combination of hatebears, disruptive artifacts, and aggressive creatures creates a strategy that can overwhelm opponents and control the pace of the game, leading to victory through efficient disruption and powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with a variety of counterspells, removal, and disruption while generating card advantage through drawing cards like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. It aims to control the game by using powerful spells like Force of Will to protect its resources and Lórien Revealed to manipulate the opponent's hand. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value by allowing the deck to recur creatures and artifacts from the graveyard. The deck also utilizes efficient creatures like Snapcaster Mage and Psychic Frog to apply pressure and slow down the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with disruptive creatures and spells like Collector Ouphe, Deathrite Shaman, and Leovold, Emissary of Trest while playing powerful planeswalkers like Oko, Thief of Crowns. It also includes efficient removal spells like Abrupt Decay and Fatal Push to deal with threats. The deck is able to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with its aggressive creatures. It also has a strong suite of counter magic with cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its own game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing Paradoxical Outcome to generate card advantage and mana acceleration, while also including vital combo pieces like Time Vault and Manifold Key to achieve a game-winning lock. The inclusion of powerful Vintage staples like Black Lotus, Ancestral Recall, and Time Walk allows for explosive starts and overwhelming advantage. The deck also features interaction and disruption in the form of Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its game plan. Overall, the deck aims to control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces and secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and card draw to quickly assemble a powerful combo involving Time Vault and Voltaic Key. Lurrus of the Dream-Den acts as a companion to provide additional value and recursion. The deck aims to generate significant mana and card advantage through Paradoxical Outcome, Stock Up, and various mana rocks to find and execute the combo as efficiently as possible. It also includes counterspells and disruption to protect the combo and control the game until the combo is assembled.

The deck focuses on using Coveted Jewel as a key piece in a combo strategy, allowing the player to generate a significant advantage by drawing cards and generating mana. The deck includes various mana acceleration cards, along with control elements such as Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to protect the combo. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces to generate a large amount of mana and draw cards with Coveted Jewel, ultimately leading to victory through card advantage and overwhelming the opponent with powerful spells and artifacts.
